title: Addendum to GPT-5 System Card: Sensitive conversations
description: This system card details GPT-5’s improvements in handling sensitive conversations, including new benchmarks for emotional reliance, mental health, and jailbreak resistance.
author: Desconocido

title: A law and tax firm redefines efficiency with ChatGPT Business
description: Learn how Steuerrecht.com uses ChatGPT Business to streamline legal workflows, automate tax research, and scale client service—helping law firms boost productivity and stay competitive.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI acquires Software Applications Incorporated, maker of Sky
description: OpenAI has acquired Software Applications Incorporated, maker of Sky—a natural language interface for Mac that brings AI directly into your desktop experience. Together, we’re integrating Sky’s deep macOS capabilities into ChatGPT to make AI more intuitive, contextual, and action-oriented.
author: Desconocido

title: Consensus accelerates research with GPT-5 and Responses API
description: Consensus uses GPT-5 and OpenAI’s Responses API to power a multi-agent research assistant that reads, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence in minutes—helping over 8 million researchers accelerate scientific discovery.
author: Desconocido

title: Work smarter with your company knowledge in ChatGPT
description: Company knowledge brings context from your apps into ChatGPT for answers specific to your business, with clear citations, security, privacy, and admin controls. Available now for Business, Enterprise, and Edu users.
author: Desconocido

title: AI in South Korea—OpenAI’s Economic Blueprint
description: OpenAI's Korea Economic Blueprint outlines how South Korea can scale trusted AI through sovereign capabilities and strategic partnerships to drive growth.
author: Desconocido

title: The next chapter for UK sovereign AI
description: OpenAI expands its UK partnership with a new Ministry of Justice agreement, bringing ChatGPT to civil servants. It also introduces UK data residency for ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Edu, and the API Platform to support trusted and secure AI adoption.
author: Desconocido

title: AI in Japan—OpenAI’s Japan Economic Blueprint
description: OpenAI’s Japan Economic Blueprint outlines how Japan can harness AI to boost innovation, strengthen competitiveness, and enable sustainable, inclusive growth.
author: Desconocido

title: Continue your ChatGPT experience beyond WhatsApp
description: ChatGPT will no longer be available on WhatsApp after January 15, 2026. Learn how to link your ChatGPT account and continue your conversations across devices.
author: Desconocido
